title: Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning with a Stochastic Actor

claims.statement: The maximum entropy objective adds policy entropy to expected reward; temperature alpha controls their relative weight and therefore policy stochasticity.
claims.scope: Definition of the continuous-control learning objective, not a guarantee of physical-robot transfer.

claims.statement: SAC trains two Q-functions independently and uses their minimum in the value and policy gradients to reduce positive estimation bias.
claims.scope: The algorithm described in this 2018 paper; do not conflate it with later automatic-temperature variants.

claims.statement: The benchmark comparison trains five instances per algorithm with different seeds and performs one evaluation rollout every 1000 environment steps; curves show means and shading shows minima and maxima across the five trials.
claims.scope: The reported benchmark protocol, not confidence intervals or independent hardware replications.
